title: Autopay Terms and the Autopay APR Reduction
content:
Autopay on Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts debits the monthly payment from the borrower's bank account on each due date.

**Terms.** Autopay is changed only on a contract whose status is active. Enrolling lowers the contract APR by the tier's autopay reduction and cancelling raises it by the same amount. The APR on the contract always shows the rate in effect, and interest already accrued is not recalculated. Enrolling when already enrolled, or cancelling when not enrolled, changes nothing.

## Condition and effect

| Contract status | Current autopay setting | Request | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| active | not enrolled | enroll | enrolled; APR lowered by the tier's autopay reduction |
| active | enrolled | cancel | not enrolled; APR raised by the same amount |
| active | enrolled | enroll | nothing changes |
| active | not enrolled | cancel | nothing changes |
| not active | any | enroll or cancel | autopay is not changed |

## Hypothetical figures

A contract at 15.59 percent on a tier with a 0.50-point autopay reduction shows 15.09 percent once enrolled; cancelling later returns it to 15.59 percent. Interest that accrued while the earlier rate was in effect stays as it accrued.
